## Summary

- Fixes #374: `certificateCovers` in `frontend/src/lib/setupsteps.ts` short-circuited to `true` whenever `tls.enabled` was false, regardless of `tls.hosts`. Since 0.2.0, syslog TLS gets a certificate independent of `tls.enabled` (loaded whenever `cfg.TLS.Enabled || cfg.Listen.SyslogTLS != ""`), so a `tls.enabled: false` + syslog-TLS-on deployment with a `tls.hosts` mismatch produced a silent "no problem" from step 0 while the router's handshake actually failed. The short-circuit now only fires when neither HTTP TLS nor syslog TLS is on, matching the server's own condition for whether a certificate is loaded at all. No wording change — the existing blocked-state copy is already framed for the router side and reads correctly for this deployment shape too.
- Adds `frontend/scripts/live-setup-wizard-tls-off-cert-mismatch.mjs`, a live-check scenario that drives the real wizard against the real server's actual `/api/setup/status` response (only `hosts` overridden to a mismatched value — everything else left as the live harness truthfully reports it) and confirms step 1 now renders blocked, with the CA-trust command withheld.

**#371 is not fixed by this PR** — see "Not fixed" below. It remains open.

## Not fixed: #371 (syslog step reports "done" on bare TCP connect)

Re-verified live at `internal/syslog/tcp_listener.go:352`: `noteConnection(host)` still fires in `ServeTCP`'s accept branch before `handleTCPConn` reads a byte or completes a TLS handshake, exactly as the issue describes. The fix the issue itself specifies is moving that hook to after a completed handshake, which requires editing `internal/syslog/tcp_listener.go` and the wiring in `main.go` (`main.go:862`, `syslog.SetOnConnection`) — both outside this agent's assigned scope (owned by a parallel workstream on this repo). I did not touch either file. Recommend the owning agent apply the fix as specified in #371's "Current plan".

## Fail-first proof (#374)

1. Added two new vitest cases to `setupsteps.test.ts` pinning the bug (`tlsEnabled:false, syslogEnabled:true`, mismatched host) and ran them against the unfixed code: one failed (`expected true to be false`), confirming it actually exercises the bug.
2. Added the live-check scenario above and ran it against the unfixed code (temporarily reverted `setupsteps.ts`, rebuilt, reran): it timed out waiting for the blocked state that should appear — genuine fail-first at the live-browser layer too.
3. Restored the fix, reran both — all pass.

## Test plan

- [x] `npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json` — 0 errors, 0 warnings, 263 files
- [x] `npx vitest run` — 15 files, 194 tests passed
- [x] `make live-check` (run with non-default `MV_DIR`/ports to avoid colliding with a concurrent parallel-agent run sharing this host — the first attempt on default ports failed with connection-refused/timeout errors from that collision, not from this change; a clean rerun on isolated ports passed all 29 scenarios twice)
- [x] No Go files touched by this PR — `gofmt`/`go vet`/`go test` not applicable

Closes #374
title: Setup wizard: check syslog TLS cert coverage even when HTTP TLS is off
